ja: ＭＧ νガンダムVer.Ka（別売）に装着しよう！
‘ ダ ブ ル ・ フ ィ ン ・ フ ァ ン ネ ル 装 備 ’ 再 現 ！ ！

en: Attach it to MG νGundamVer.Ka (sold separately)!
‘Double fin funnel equipment’ reproduction! !
Introducing an expansion unit that customizes the MG νGundamVer.Ka (sold separately) to double fin funnel specifications!
A powerful double fin funnel. Enjoy the dynamic display as well as the fearless figure.
Check out the “Special Feature” for more details! ! (https://p-bandai.jp/hobby/special-1000002843/)
(Set contents)
● Fin Funnel x 6 pieces
●“Ver.Ka” Marking (water transfer decal) x 1 sheet
● Beam effect x 6 pieces
● Dedicated display base × 1 unit
● Connection arm x 6
This product is 20121215 Store Release Scheduled "MG νGundamVer.Ka" (sold separately)
An expansion unit that allows you to customize and enjoy “double fin funnel equipment”.
*This product does not include "MG νGundamVer.Ka".
* This product and "MG νGundamVer.Ka" (sold separately) are required to reproduce the combination example shown in the photo.
Also, "MG νGundamVer.Ka" (sold separately) is not available for sale at Premium Bandai.
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product materials: PS, PE, ABS, PP
・No adhesive is used for assembly
《MG νGundamVer.Ka is not included in this product》
*The finished product in the photo is painted.
*The kit in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
(Reference) "MG νGundamVer.Ka" (sold separately) includes a

6 connection arms are included in advance. (*Each specification is the same as this product)
